title: Japanese hitodama soul orbs

tellings.quote: Japanese concept of the hitoama but it's these uh plasma orbs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talking with a parapsychology researcher named Jeffrey Mishlove, brings up hitodama, a Japanese idea of glowing orbs tied to the souls of the dead, which Michels describes as plasma orbs. He points to the film The Boy and the Heron by the Japanese animator Hayao Miyazaki, linking these old folk ideas to the glowing orbs people report today.
